entities.name: Squee

events.summary: Orim wakes with no memory and a dead guard's blood on her hands.
events.quote: the first thing she could remember was waking up with the dead guard's blood on her hands.

events.summary: Cho-Manno declares Mercadia's masks can no longer hide the truth.
events.quote: Our day has come at last.

events.summary: Ta-Karnst wishes the River claim Cho-Manno's body.
events.quote: May the River claim Cho-Manno's body, wherever it lies.

events.summary: Cho-Manno tells Orim he did not choose his role and neither did Gerrard.
events.quote: I did not choose my role, Orim," said Cho-Manno patiently

events.summary: Orim condemns Gerrard and he offers no defense.
events.quote: Gerrard offered no defense to Orim's condemnation

events.summary: Orim teaches Ta-Karnst and the Cho-Arrim healers a less invasive healing method.
events.quote: Orim taught Ta-Karnst and the other Cho-Arrim healers a far less invasive method of healing.

events.summary: Sisay asks to return to Mercadia City and a vizier says it is easy.
events.quote: I need to get back to Mercadia City," said Sisay.

events.summary: Gerrard was the Mercadian soldiers' hero; they stumbled when he left.
events.quote: Gerrard was the Mercadian soldiers' greatest hero; they followed him blindly.

events.summary: Karn grasps the powerstone and ends the wild flashing.
events.quote: Karn said nothing—he just grasped the powerstone and squeezed tightly.

events.summary: Gerrard realizes the woman rescued from Rath is not helpless.
events.quote: Gerrard realized that the helpless woman they'd rescued from Rath was nothing of the sort.

events.summary: Squee watches his Kyren cousins fall with sympathy and relief.
events.quote: Squee watched his Kyren cousins fall with a mixture of sympathy and relief.

events.summary: Tahngarth glances at Takara who is unaffected by the specter's wail.
events.quote: Tahngarth glanced at Takara.

events.summary: Starke knows the voice is Takara's but the venom is Volrath's.
events.quote: Starke knew the voice was Takara's, but the venom was Volrath's.

events.summary: Gerrard tells Sisay the ceremonial guards are disciplined but could not fight.
events.quote: They couldn't fight their way out of a broom closet, but they've got discipline.

events.summary: Gerrard crashes and thinks it is not the start he hoped for.
events.quote: Gerrard shook his head as the ground rushed to meet him.

events.summary: Gerrard ends up fighting the irregulars he trained.
events.quote: Had Gerrard realized he'd end up fighting against them

events.summary: The Weatherlight bursts from the underground hangar as Mercadia falls.
events.quote: the *Weatherlight* burst from the underground hangar.

events.summary: Squee stumbles on the hidden hangar chasing a fly.
events.quote: Squee stumbled on the hidden hangar.

events.summary: Tahngarth roars at Squee being called general.
events.quote: General *nuisance*, maybe.

events.summary: Gerrard and Sisay run deeper into the mountain unwilling to leave without the Weatherlight and crew.
events.quote: Neither of them intended to leave Mercadia without the *Weatherlight* and its crew.

events.summary: Cho-Manno resolves to ally with Gerrard to free his people.
events.quote: Cho-Manno knew he had no choice but to ally with Gerrard.

events.summary: Gerrard recalls the living wreath Mirri laid for her kin.
events.quote: recalling the living wreath Mirri laid for her dead kin.

events.summary: Sisay is restored, the Legacy recovered, and the Weatherlight sails for Dominaria.
events.quote: the *Weatherlight* was sailing home to Dominaria.

events.summary: Karn repairs the planeswalking engine and sees how to catalyze the Weatherlight's evolution.
events.quote: Karn saw for the first time how he could catalyze the *Weatherlight*'s evolution.

relations.quote: Cho-Manno knew he had no choice but to ally with Gerrard.

relations.note: They flee into the mountain together.
relations.quote: Gerrard and Sisay ran deeper into the mountain.
The magistrate had been the goblins' puppet for so long

relations.note: Venom is Volrath's in her voice.
